approval.text: Profile of EXECUTION_PLAN_LLM_2026-09-21_RU.md section 3 adopted by the executor under the author's delegation of 22.09.2026 (for this step and all following, choose the best option). Not an independent scientific decision recorded by the author; a revision by the author creates a new protocol version.

scope_disclaimer: Results describe the specified synthetic model of Tashkent Line 51 and do not establish operational benefits.

data.stop_order: file order of 05_Pipeline/route51_gen/data/Busstations.csv (S01..S23); forward = S01->S23, reverse = S23->S01

periods.note: off_peak is two separate blocks; no trips and no waiting across the 07:00-19:00 gap

crowding.formula: lambda = 1 + (lambda_full - 1) * max(0, (phi - theta)/(1 - theta)); crowd_min = sum((lambda - 1) * L * t)
crowding.segment_times: distance-proportional inter-stop times normalised so each direction sums to 41 min; layover excluded
crowding.load_basis: relaxation: n = duration/headway, c = 90 + 60*share; after dispatch: actual trip counts and mean capacity per period block and direction
crowding.phi_gt_1: flagged as exceeding full capacity; queues and denied boarding are not modelled
crowding.legacy_control: crowd_penalty 10 overcrowding proxy kept only as legacy_overcrowd_proxy

optimisation.algorithm: NSGA-II (pymoo 0.6.2), SBX prob 0.9 eta 15, PM eta 20
optimisation.candidate_pool: union of final non-dominated feasible solutions of the three central seeds
optimisation.selection_rule: minimise wait + crowd_min (pax-min/day) among candidates feasible after dispatch re-evaluation; ties: lower cost, then lexicographically smaller stable id '<seed>:<index>'
optimisation.dispatch_fallback: if the selected candidate is infeasible after dispatch, take the next candidate by the same rule; if none, report that no feasible executable candidate exists
optimisation.convergence_criterion: relative hypervolume gain over the last 20% of generations <= 1% for each of the three central seeds, common reference point per comparison; undefined if HV = 0
optimisation.convergence_fallback: one repeat with 600 generations for all three central seeds; any further extension or acceptance of limited convergence recorded before S14

dispatch.blocks: each continuous period block and direction separately
dispatch.departures: block_start + k*h for k = 0, 1, ... while < block_end; identical for both termini
dispatch.fleet_mix: n_large = floor(f*N + 0.5) per block and direction; trip k is large iff floor((k+1)*n_large/N) - floor(k*n_large/N) = 1
dispatch.cohort: planned departure in [07:00, 10:00) from the first stop of its direction, both directions
dispatch.wait_after_dispatch: uniform passenger arrivals within each block; wait per block = sum over gaps g of g^2/2 per unit arrival rate; first gap measured from block start
dispatch.operational_feasibility: unknown (no vehicle blocks or duty scheduling)

simulation.network: two directional linear corridors S01->S23 and S23->S01, straight-line stop-to-stop lengths, 30 km/h, 2 lanes per direction with background traffic
simulation.service_trips: all dispatch trips of both directions with planned departure in [06:30, 11:30); only cohort trips are measured
simulation.background: randomTrips.py period 4 s, fringe factor 15, insertion over [06:30, 11:30), duarouter; missing SUMO_HOME/tools is an error, never a silent run without background
simulation.dwell: 5 s + 1.5 s/pax * (1 - speedup * is_18m) * (boardings + alightings per trip at the stop, by direction and period), lognormal noise sigma 0.25, minimum 3 s

boarding_speedup_18m.applied_to: actual vehicle type of each trip

simulation.seed_derivation: SUMO --seed = run seed; randomTrips --seed = run seed; dwell noise rng = numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([run_seed, 2]))
invalid_run: a cohort bus is planned but not inserted, not arrived by the guard end, teleported or removed
SUMO error or missing required tool
simulation.background_teleports: counted and reported per run; not an exclusion criterion
simulation.invalid_run_handling: no seed replacement; an invalid run makes the series non-confirmatory; if the cause is only the guard limit, a documented fix and a full rerun with the same seeds under a new run_id

hypothesis.statement: In the specified synthetic model, the registered candidate plan reduces the mean full-trip bus duration of the 07:00-10:00 departure cohort, averaged over both directions, relative to the baseline timetable.
hypothesis.refinement_note: Explicit refinement of the earlier passenger-time H1: the measured outcome is bus full-trip duration, not individual passenger in-vehicle time. The original formulation stays visible in the thesis.

primary_outcome.per_bus: tripinfo duration = arrival at the last stop - actual departure from the first stop, minutes
primary_outcome.per_run: mean over cohort buses within each direction, then 0.5*mean_fwd + 0.5*mean_rev
primary_outcome.observation_unit: one value per run (never individual buses)

experiment.sensitivity_seeds: speedup 0%/15% candidate runs reuse candidate seeds 200001..200030; baseline shared when its condition fingerprint is identical; not independent samples of each other
experiment.n_fixed: n is not increased after viewing the effect

analysis.delta: baseline - candidate (positive = shorter duration under the candidate)
analysis.ci: 95% Welch-Satterthwaite interval of the difference of means
secondary_exploratory: Mann-Whitney U two-sided as sensitivity, never a replacement of the primary test
headway regularity at the terminal (coefficient of variation)
analysis.multiplicity: single primary test; secondary analyses are exploratory and carry no confirmatory claims

scopes: all_day_with_simulation (null until all periods are simulated)
economics.value_of_time: 0.45 * net hourly wage, Tashkent city (MHOBT 1726), indicator 2.02.02.1200, 2026 Q1-Q2 mean, 12% PIT, 168 h/month

sensitivity_layer3.crowding: one factor at a time from central: theta 0.6/0.8/0.9; forms ramp/step/none; lambda_full 2/2.32
sensitivity_layer3.relative_cost: r = 1.3/1.5/1.7 with seeds 42/43/44, same search budget
controls: simple rule: baseline headways kept, deterministic feasible integer fleet mix within the same budget
no telecom prior: re-fusion without the prior into a separate output

K1_checks: unit and integration tests of S03-S11 pass
3+3 technical runs: planned = inserted = arrived for every cohort bus; no cohort teleports or removals
both directions carry buses and demand; mixed fleet present in the candidate
dispatch identical in layer 3, SUMO input and export
runtime measured to cost the full series
tuning_rules: Only technical settings (guard end, time-to-teleport) may change after K1, only to fix a documented defect, identically for both conditions and before S14; scientific coefficients are never tuned on trial effects.
